requirement.text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes on-board railway equipment (ERTMS) performing an automatic self-test at startup, which is an embedded/hardware-centric railway system rather than a web, mobile, or AI application.

rounds.text_checked: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies an action ('perform an automatic self-test') triggered by the system transition into a specific state ('Start Up'), making 'state_based' testing appropriate. Additionally, startup and self-testing form part of a multi-step operational sequence with downstream dependencies (such as PURE-ERTMS-R8 depending on this requirement), justifying 'use_case' testing.

test_cases.title: Automatic self-test triggered upon transition to Start Up state
test_cases.preconditions: On-board equipment is powered off and in a valid initial state.
steps: Apply power to the on-board equipment.
Trigger transition to the Start Up state.
test_cases.expected_result: The on-board equipment transitions to Start Up state and automatically initiates the self-test routine without external intervention.

test_cases.title: End-to-end system startup sequence and self-test execution
test_cases.preconditions: System is powered down with all hardware interfaces connected.
steps: Initiate system startup by powering on the ERTMS on-board equipment.
Observe the automatic execution of the self-test during Start Up.
Verify self-test completion and transition to the next state or result notification.
test_cases.expected_result: The self-test runs automatically as part of the startup workflow and provides execution status for downstream components like the DMI.

final_text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.
